description: Create a new task in a List from an existing task template, copying the template's structure (subtasks, checklists, custom fields). Returns the created task. Use after `get_task_templates` to obtain the `template_id`.

due_date.description: Optional due date. Accepts natural language ('tomorrow', 'in 3 days', '+2h'), ISO date, or epoch milliseconds.

list_id.description: ID of the destination List where the task will be created.

template_id.description: ID of the task template to instantiate (from `get_task_templates`).

name: create_task_from_template
